title: Mixed commutator coefficients of universal right translation
statement: For an arbitrary scheme $S$ and group scheme $G/S$ [def-sc-group-scheme], let $v,w,t$ be points over $S[\eta]$ [def-sc-dual-numbers] reducing to the identity. Define $D_v(U)$ to be the $\eta$ coefficient of the comorphism of right translation by $v$ on the universal point of $G$, as an additive endomorphism of $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_G)$ for every open $U$. If the lift of $t$ by $\eta\mapsto\epsilon\delta$ equals $v_\epsilon w_\delta v_\epsilon^{-1}w_\delta^{-1}$, then $D_t=D_v D_w-D_w D_v$, with multiplication the composition of additive endomorphisms. No affine, field, smoothness or characteristic hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lie-ring obligation docstrings, invariant-extension and mixed-coefficient steps (blueprint sk-d-tangent).

proof.text: Pull right translations back to G[epsilon][delta]. Their comorphisms act coefficientwise as 1+epsilon D_v and 1+delta D_w and fix both parameters. Their inverses are 1-epsilon D_v and 1-delta D_w, because the corresponding parameter squares vanish.

Compose the four operators in the order of the stated group commutator. The surviving mixed coefficient is D_v D_w-D_w D_v. The assumed equality of points identifies this map with translation by t pulled back through eta=epsilon delta, whose mixed coefficient is D_t. Equality of section maps gives the equality on all opens.

theorem invariantCoefficient_of_mixed_commutator (v w t : infPoints G)
    (h : Scheme.dualNumbersMulOver S ≫ t.1 =
      (Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1) * (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1) *
        (Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1)⁻¹ *
          (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1)⁻¹) :
    invariantCoefficient G t =
      invariantCoefficient G v * invariantCoefficient G w -
        invariantCoefficient G w * invariantCoefficient G v
